# ruvllm

> Change a model. Prove it. Keep the original.

Change a model. Prove it. Keep the original.

This is an independent, art-directed explainer for ruvnet's ruvllm — it takes a newcomer from "never seen it" to "ready to implement", grounded in a real RVF knowledge base of the source.

## What it is
ruvllm: A master sheet and a sheet of tracing vellum. The base model is a printed master that is never touched. Every change is drawn only on a translucent vellum overlay. A wax-sealed envelope holding the keep-rule is closed before any answer is written. The two sheets are read side by side, task by task, in a paired ledger.

## For your AI
A downloadable knowledge pack (RVF vector KB + MCP server) ships with this page so your agent can search the source too: https://ruvllm-explainer.netlify.app/ruvllm-knowledge-pack.zip
